nodes.label: CLIENT_SERVLET_FUNCTIONS
nodes.desc: Registry tuple wiring every /_matrix/client servlet into the JsonResource (L85).

nodes.label: HttpTransactionCache
nodes.desc: Deduplicates PUT requests carrying a txn_id so client retries never double-send a message (L50).

nodes.label: RoomSendEventRestServlet
nodes.desc: PATTERNS /rooms/{roomId}/send/{eventType} (L429); register_txn_path (L1700) also registers the PUT .../{txnId} variant that runs through txns.fetch_or_execute_request (L518).

nodes.label: SyncRestServlet
nodes.desc: GET /sync entry point (L87); long-polls against a since token before returning the timeline.

nodes.label: EventCreationHandler
nodes.desc: create_and_send_nonmember_event (L978) builds the event, applies rate limits and the room_event_creation_limit Linearizer (L518), then persists; worker mode forwards via ReplicationSendEventsRestServlet.make_client (L512).

nodes.label: ReplicationSendEventsRestServlet
nodes.desc: HTTP replication endpoint invoked at message.py L1794 when a worker event creator hands persistence to the writer instance for the room.

nodes.label: EventsPersistenceStorageController
nodes.desc: persist_events (L405) partitions events per room and drains them through the per-room _EventPeristenceQueue (L200); _persist_event_batch at L593.

nodes.label: Extremities & state delta
nodes.desc: _calculate_new_forward_extremities_and_state_delta (L848) and _calculate_state_delta (L1543) keep the event DAG and current state tables consistent.

nodes.label: PersistEventsStore
nodes.desc: _persist_events_txn (L1084) and _persist_event_auth_chain_txn (L1296) commit event rows, state groups and stream ordering in one SQL transaction.

nodes.label: Databases (data stores)
nodes.desc: Splits persistence across four stores: main, state, persist_events and state_deletion (L51-68), optionally on separate physical databases.

nodes.label: Notifier
nodes.desc: on_new_room_events (L357) queues pending entries, wakes user streams once earlier positions have landed (L416) and calls notify_replication (L441) to publish stream tokens.

nodes.label: SyncHandler
nodes.desc: wait_for_sync_for_user (L633) parks each /sync request on a notifier deferred, then slices timelines between stream tokens.

nodes.label: EventsStream
nodes.desc: NAME='events' (L148-151) with current-state and backfill row variants; the source of RDATA rows for every worker.

nodes.label: FederationStream
nodes.desc: NAME='federation' (L38-48); only populated when the master does not send federation itself, letting a sender worker pull the rows.

nodes.label: ReplicationCommandHandler
nodes.desc: on_RDATA (L551) / on_rdata (L627) dispatch stream rows into each worker's caches and handlers.

nodes.label: RedisSubscriber
nodes.desc: Redis pub/sub transport (L84) used in multi-worker deployments instead of one TCP connection per worker.

nodes.label: WorkerConfig
nodes.desc: Assigns the send_federation duty to specific instances (L301) and maps workers via instance_map (L309).

nodes.label: FederationRemoteSendQueue
nodes.desc: On non-sender instances this buffer (L86) queues PDUs/EDUs as replication rows exposed through get_replication_rows (L297).

nodes.label: FederationSender
nodes.desc: notify_new_events (L529) triggers _process_event_queue_loop (L549) which routes each event into per-destination queues; _send_pdu at L821, wake_destination at L1118.

nodes.label: PerDestinationQueue
nodes.desc: One queue per remote host (L161); attempt_new_transaction (L403) starts _transaction_transmission_loop (L442), which batches PDUs, EDUs, receipts and device updates.

nodes.label: TransactionManager
nodes.desc: send_new_transaction (L84) signs and posts the transaction, retrying with backoff through the transport layer call at L184.

nodes.label: TransportLayerClient
nodes.desc: send_transaction (L257) is the wire call: JSON payload to the remote server's federation endpoint over TLS with server signing.

nodes.label: FederationSendServlet
nodes.desc: PATH /send/{transaction_id} (L80); on_PUT (L88) checks origin auth then calls on_incoming_transaction (L141).

nodes.label: FederationServer
nodes.desc: on_incoming_transaction (L317) queues PDUs, backfills missing prevs, and dispatches EDUs through FederationHandlerRegistry.on_edu (L1717).

nodes.label: FederationEventHandler
nodes.desc: on_receive_pdu (L195) and _process_received_pdu (L1561) verify signatures and auth; _get_missing_events_for_pdu (L805) pulls missing prev events.

nodes.label: TypingWriterHandler
nodes.desc: started_typing (L310) records the state locally and _push_remote (L164) emits m.typing EDUs per host via build_and_send_edu (L189).

nodes.label: FollowerTypingHandler
nodes.desc: Base class (L76) that consumes TypingStream rows (L202) and inbound m.typing EDUs in _recv_edu (L397).

nodes.label: PresenceHandler
nodes.desc: Tracks user state (L872); maybe_send_presence_to_interested_destinations (L426) fans m.presence out to interested homeservers at L450.

nodes.label: PresenceFederationQueue
nodes.desc: Bridges presence deltas from any worker to the federation sender over replication (L2669, L2742).
